Blueprint:
## Modernization Blueprint: loan-service

### 1. Liferay Objects
- Loan (ERC `C_LOAN`, endpoint `/o/c/loans`):
  - `bookTitle` (String, Text, required)
  - `borrowerEmail` (String, Text, required)
  - `loanDate` (Date, Date)
  - `dueDate` (Date, Date)
  - `returnDate` (Date, Date)
  - `lateFee` (Double, Decimal)
  - `loanStatus` (String, Picklist `PL_LOAN_STATUS`: onLoan, returned), renamed from the reserved `status` column

### 2. Batch Client Extension
- `loan-object`: folder, picklist `PL_LOAN_STATUS`, Loan definition with its actions.

### 3. Frontend
- None (no portlets in this module).

### 4. Custom logic
- LoanLocalServiceImpl.addLoan: sets the loan and due dates (+14 days) and the status -> microservice action on `onAfterAdd`.
  The e-mail check becomes an Object Validation (manual step).
- LoanLocalServiceImpl.returnLoan: late fee of 0.50 per day -> microservice action on `onAfterUpdate` when `returnDate` is set.
- LoanModelListener.onAfterUpdate: POST to the inventory system with a custom payload -> same microservice, `onAfterUpdate`.
- LoanModelListener.onAfterCreate: logging only -> entry history.
- LoanLocalServiceImpl.getOverdueLoans: REST filter `dueDate lt [date] and loanStatus eq 'onLoan'`.

### 5. API CONTRACT
- Object `Loan`, ERC `C_LOAN`, endpoint `/o/c/loans`.
- Picklist `PL_LOAN_STATUS`, entries URL `/o/headless-admin-list-type/v1.0/list-type-definitions/by-external-reference-code/PL_LOAN_STATUS/list-type-entries`.
- Actions: `setLoanDates` (`C_LOAN_ACTION_SET_LOAN_DATES`, onAfterAdd, `function#loan-rules-object-action`),
  `processReturn` (`C_LOAN_ACTION_PROCESS_RETURN`, onAfterUpdate, `function#loan-rules-object-action`).
- Microservice: `loan-rules-object-action`, port 58081.

CUSTOM LOGIC TO PORT (one line per method, with the Object Action trigger it maps to; the code is in the files below):
- LoanModelListener.onAfterUpdate (model listener) -> onAfterUpdate, calls an external system
- LoanModelListener.onAfterCreate (model listener) -> onAfterAdd, logging only
- LoanLocalServiceImpl.addLoan (local service impl) -> onAfterAdd
- LoanLocalServiceImpl.returnLoan (local service impl) -> standalone
- LoanLocalServiceImpl.getOverdueLoans (local service impl) -> query
Decide for EACH line (mapping playbook 3.1): 'logging only' -> entry history, no action; logic a native action can express
(set fields, create an entry, e-mail, plain HTTP POST) -> native Object Action; anything else (calculations, conditions on several fields,
calls to external systems with custom payloads, several steps) -> the Spring Boot objectAction microservice; 'query' methods -> REST
filters in the frontend; validations that throw -> Object Validations. Name every decision in the blueprint.

REQUIRED FIELD RENAMES (these service.xml columns use names Liferay Objects reserve; use the new names everywhere: objectFields, API CONTRACT, frontend, notification terms):
- Loan.status -> loanStatus

--- File: java:listener:LoanModelListener.java ---
package com.acme.loans.model.listener;

import com.acme.loans.model.Loan;
import com.liferay.portal.kernel.exception.ModelListenerException;
import com.liferay.portal.kernel.log.Log;
import com.liferay.portal.kernel.log.LogFactoryUtil;
import com.liferay.portal.kernel.model.BaseModelListener;
import com.liferay.portal.kernel.model.ModelListener;

import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;

import org.osgi.service.component.annotations.Component;

@Component(service = ModelListener.class)
public class LoanModelListener extends BaseModelListener<Loan> {

	/** When a book comes back, tell the inventory system so the copy is available again. */
	@Override
	public void onAfterUpdate(Loan originalLoan, Loan loan) throws ModelListenerException {
		if (!"returned".equals(loan.getStatus()) || "returned".equals(originalLoan.getStatus())) {
			return;
		}

		String json = "{\"title\": \"" + loan.getBookTitle() + "\", \"lateFee\": " + loan.getLateFee() + "}";

		try {
			HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create("https://inventory.acme.com/api/returns"))
				.header("Content-Type", "application/json")
				.POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(json))
				.build();

			HttpResponse<String> response = HttpClient.newHttpClient().send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString());

			if (response.statusCode() >= 400) {
				_log.error("Inventory rejected return of " + loan.getBookTitle() + ": " + response.body());
			}
		}
		catch (Exception e) {
			throw new ModelListenerException(e);
		}
	}

	@Override
	public void onAfterCreate(Loan loan) throws ModelListenerException {
		_log.info("Loan created for " + loan.getBorrowerEmail());
	}

	private static final Log _log = LogFactoryUtil.getLog(LoanModelListener.class);

}


--- File: java:localservice:LoanLocalServiceImpl.java ---
package com.acme.loans.service.impl;

import com.acme.loans.exception.LoanBorrowerEmailException;
import com.acme.loans.model.Loan;
import com.acme.loans.service.base.LoanLocalServiceBaseImpl;
import com.liferay.portal.aop.AopService;
import com.liferay.portal.kernel.util.Validator;

import java.util.Date;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

import org.osgi.service.component.annotations.Component;

@Component(property = "model.class.name=com.acme.loans.model.Loan", service = AopService.class)
public class LoanLocalServiceImpl extends LoanLocalServiceBaseImpl {

	/** A loan lasts 14 days; the borrower must have a valid e-mail address. */
	public Loan addLoan(String bookTitle, String borrowerEmail) throws Exception {
		if (!Validator.isEmailAddress(borrowerEmail)) {
			throw new LoanBorrowerEmailException("Invalid e-mail: " + borrowerEmail);
		}

		Loan loan = loanPersistence.create(counterLocalService.increment());

		Date now = new Date();

		loan.setBookTitle(bookTitle);
		loan.setBorrowerEmail(borrowerEmail);
		loan.setLoanDate(now);
		loan.setDueDate(new Date(now.getTime() + TimeUnit.DAYS.toMillis(14)));
		loan.setStatus("onLoan");

		return loanPersistence.update(loan);
	}

	/** Late returns pay 0.50 per day after the due date. */
	public Loan returnLoan(long loanId) throws Exception {
		Loan loan = loanPersistence.findByPrimaryKey(loanId);

		Date now = new Date();

		long daysLate = TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toDays(now.getTime() - loan.getDueDate().getTime());

		loan.setReturnDate(now);
		loan.setLateFee(daysLate > 0 ? daysLate * 0.5 : 0);
		loan.setStatus("returned");

		return loanPersistence.update(loan);
	}

	public List<Loan> getOverdueLoans(Date date) {
		return loanFinder.findByDueDateBeforeAndStatus(date, "onLoan");
	}

}
